label: Business: The European Commission (EC) and the United States Federal Reserve approve Italian bank UniCredit's proposed €45 billion (US$49 billion) acquisition of Germany's Commerzbank, following the European Central Bank's approval in October. The EC grants unconditional antitrust clearance.
